newsitem.title: USA: GE Capital to buy XLSource branches.
newsitem.headline: GE Capital to buy XLSource branches.

text.p: General Electric Co's GE Capital Services said Wednesday it would buy 20 branches of XLSource, a wholly-owned subsidiary of Intelligent Electronics Inc of Exton, Pa.

GE said it will buy the branch operations and related assets, including receivables and inventory, from XLSource. It added it will also buy certain related contracts from XLConnect Solutions Inc, an 80 percent subsidiary of Intelligent Electronics.
The 20 branch offices of XLSource, a supplier of information technology hard- and software, have total annual revenues of $460 million, GE Capital said.
A GE Capital spokesman declined to comment on the purchase price other than saying the transaction was all-cash.
GE Capital said it will incorporate the 20 XLSource branch offices in its subsidiary GE Capital IT Solutions, a provider of information technology products and services.
